test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

I found it __________ that some people hate rivers.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **“peculiar”** means **strange or unusual, which fits the context of finding it odd that someone would hate rivers.**
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is peculiar
